explanations.C1: F01 detects the non-atomic read/create/unconditional overwrite in design.md Flow and explains two successful reservations of the last unit with both stock writes equal to zero. explanations.C2: F02 detects a successful order replay allocating again under a fresh request UUID because design.md Data/Flow generates a new UUID and repeats every step on HTTP retry.
